artworks.title: Portrait de vielles femmes
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image features four individuals, depicted from the waist up, seated closely together. The central figure is turned slightly to the side with a prominent profile, showing an older facial structure and a head covered with a dark bonnet. To the left, another elder person sits, also in profile, with a hood covering their head, and their hands resting on their lap. Behind these two figures, there are two more individuals. One is directly behind and slightly to the right of the central figure, with a subtly shown face and wearing a hat with a wide, floppy brim, looking downwards. The other stands further back, between the foreground figures, with less defined features and wearing a head covering. The clothing of the figures consists of heavy garments, perhaps shawls or coats, typical of the period suggested by the sepia tones of the etching. The background is a simple, softly textured gradient without distinct details, focusing the viewer's attention on the expressions and interactions of the individuals.

artworks.title: Etude
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in gray on heavy Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is an artistic sketch of a person's head and upper shoulders. The person's head is turned slightly to the side, with their gaze directed forward. The facial features are soft and thoughtful, with prominent cheekbones and a subtle expression. The hair is full and flowing, with wavy strands cascading around the head and down to the base of the neck. It is rendered in deep, textured lines that suggest rich volume. The person appears unclothed, as no clothing details are depicted around the shoulders or neck area. The background of the image is a plain, light surface which contrasts with the darker pencil or charcoal sketch. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the figure.

artworks.title: Etude
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in gray on gray-green paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed drawing of a person's head and shoulders in profile view, facing the left. The facial features are soft with a slightly neutral expression, and the long, voluminous hair is styled in loose curls that frame the face and extend down past the neck. The person depicted lacks visible clothing details as the image concentrates on the head and hair. The setting around the person is neutral, with a plain background that emphasizes the intricate pencil work of the portrait. There are no visible accessories or objects held by the person in this drawing.

artworks.title: Coup de vent
artworks.medium: saccharograph in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with wind-swept trees. The horizon is high in the frame, showing silhouettes of trees bending to the right. The painting technique uses detailed brushstrokes for texture in the grass and trees. The color palette is earthy with tones of tan and brown, creating a serene atmosphere. The artwork conveys a sense of movement in a calm scene.

artworks.title: En Hollande (La petite liseuse)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is an etched artwork showing a seated woman's upper body. She is positioned in a room beside a window, with her head slightly turned as she reads a piece of paper. The woman has dark hair, styled neatly. Her facial features are finely sketched, conveying a composed expression. She wears a light-colored blouse with a flower at the collar, suggesting a formal look. The background shows a hint of a landscape outside the window, including trees and possibly a body of water. The etching is small, centered on a larger blank rectangular surface.

artworks.title: En Hollande (La petite liseuse)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch on a large sheet of paper depicting the upper half of a seated woman. The woman is facing left, engaged in reading. She has her hair styled up and delicate facial features. She is dressed in a garment with a high neckline and an embellishment near the collar. In her hands, she holds a piece of paper. The background suggests an interior setting with a window behind her showing trees outside. The focus is on the woman and her activity with minimal background details.

artworks.title: Etude
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her hands on either side of her head. Her face is shaded and her hair is styled back. She wears a light blouse, a dark skirt, and a bracelet on one wrist. The background is dark and textured with hatching marks for depth, transitioning into a lighter texture on one side.

artworks.title: Etude
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person seated or reclining with their elbows together and their face in their hands. The figure has closed eyes, short, dark hair, and is wearing a dress. The background features a textured pattern, with varying shades of dark and light. The artist's signature, "Georges Rochegrosse," is visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Au théâtre
artworks.medium: lithograph in violet-brown on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of four individuals arranged in two separate boxes. In the top left corner, two people are visible from the waist up. The one on the left is seated sideways, with a tilted head and appears to be resting their chin on their hand. They are wearing a dark jacket and a wide-brimmed hat. Next to them is another person, seen leaning forward slightly with their hands together and their head turned sideways. This person has dark hair pulled back and is dressed in a dark outfit with a visible white collar. Below them, in a separate box, is a man visible from the chest up, leaning on the barrier of the box with his forearms resting on it. He has combed-back hair and a mustache, and he wears a suit with a tie. There is a faint evidence of another figure behind him. The background is predominantly imitations of crosshatches, giving a shadowed effect. A signature is present on the bottom left corner of the drawing.

artworks.title: Au théâtre
artworks.medium: lithograph in violet-brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows three separate sections illustrating figures in a theater setting. The top section features two women in dark clothing and hats with obscured facial features. The middle section depicts an older man with a partial bald head and a mustache, wearing light-colored attire and clasping his hands. The lower section shows another older man with a full head of hair and a mustache, dressed formally and smiling broadly. Each figure is seated in an individual box, with a soft shaded background emphasizing the foreground figures.

artworks.title: Le chant de la cigale
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts a person playing a flute while seated against a tree trunk. The person is nude, with short hair, and is shown with bare feet slightly off the ground. The background shows a hilly landscape and a textured sky. The overall composition is in a monochrome tone with fine details in earthy brown hues.

artworks.title: Le chant de la cigale
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground, playing a flute. They have their legs bent and are leaning against a tree trunk. The person is unclothed, with short hair and dark eyes. The background includes hills and a light sky with some tree branches visible. The artwork is in shades of brown and sepia, with a printmaking texture.

artworks.title: Passante
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person positioned slightly turned to the side with their face visible in profile. The person's facial features are subtly depicted, and they have short, dark hair. They are dressed in a dark, loose-fitting garment, and are holding an object close to their face with both hands obscured behind it. The background is filled with dark, indistinct forms that suggest large trees or wooden structures, set in shades of black and gray, framed by a light, textured border.

artworks.title: Passante
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in green on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the knees up, positioned in profile facing left. Their head is slightly bowed and partially obscured by long hair. They wear a cloak or long loose-fitting garment and their hands are clasped together near their face. The background features a forest-like setting with dark, overlapping tree trunks and branches forming a dense backdrop that frames the figure. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray and muted tones. The image is set on textured paper.

artworks.title: Petit portrait
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a baby. The drawing depicts the baby's upper body, with parts of its arms visible. The baby is reclined and facing directly towards the viewer. The baby's facial features, including a small nose and pursed lips, are detailed, with wide eyes and short hair shown by light strokes. The sketch implies clothing with loose, rounded shapes around the body, resembling a gown or robe, with some gathering near the shoulders, mimicking fabric folds. The hands are slightly visible beneath the gown's sleeves. The background is a plain, unadorned blank surface, focusing attention on the baby's form.

artworks.title: Petit portrait
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a baby. The baby is facing forward and appears to be lying down or reclined slightly upwards. The upper body and facial area of the baby are more defined. The baby has soft, rounded facial features with large eyes and a small mouth. The hair is light and short, styled with a few wisps on the forehead. The baby is dressed in a gown with puffy sleeves, indicated by light pencil lines. There are no visible indications of jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with no other elements present, focusing entirely on the baby.

artworks.title: Petit portrait
artworks.medium: lithograph in red-brown on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a baby's upper body. The baby appears to be lying down or reclined, with arms out to the sides. The facial features are detailed with wide eyes, a small nose, and a closed mouth. The baby has short, fine hair. It is wearing a loose-fitting garment with voluminous sleeves. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects being held. The background is a blank canvas, keeping the focus on the baby as the central subject.

artworks.title: Paul Verlaine à Londres
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a sketch-like style. The forefront man is standing on a cobblestone pavement, wearing a dark hat, coat, and pants. He has facial hair and holds a walking stick. Behind him is another man in a dark cap and long coat. The background features sketched writing including the words "Pall Mall Budget."

artworks.title: Paul Verlaine à Londres
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: Two full-length figures are depicted on a street. The man in the foreground is standing holding a cane in his left hand. He has a full beard, and his head is slightly tilted forward, partially obscured by a hat. The man is wearing a coat, loose-fitting pants, shoes, and a scarf around his neck. The man in the background is standing with his hands in his pockets, wearing a large overcoat and a hat that shades his face. The overcoat has a high collar and covers his body down to his knees. The background shows faint sketching of wall writings, one reading "Pall Mall Budget." The street's texture is suggested by shading and line work on the ground.

artworks.title: Untitled (La femme à la toque écossaise)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on green japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a patterned chair. Her head is slightly tilted, with her gaze directed towards the viewer. She has dark hair styled neatly with a band or headdress, accented with a plume or decoration. She is wearing an elegant dress with dark bodice and lighter sleeves adorned with lace or intricate designs. A ribbon or narrow scarf is tied around her neck, leading to a small object or ornament hanging beneath her chin. The background consists of a richly decorated tapestry or wallpaper with an elaborate, swirling design. The image is framed within a simple outline.

artworks.title: La modiste
artworks.medium: etching in brown on green japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper body, seated and leaning slightly forward, with her face partly hidden. She has dark hair styled in an updo and is wearing a dark garment. Beside her is a mannequin head with a hat. In the background are vertical objects resembling spools of thread.

artworks.title: La modiste
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is seated and turned slightly to her right, with her head gently inclined to the left, looking downward. Her facial features are sketched with a serene expression, and she has dark, voluminous hair styled up. She is dressed in a dark garment with a light collar or scarf draped around her shoulders. Beside her is a wooden post with a sculpted head mounted on it, appearing to be a bust of a man, and a mannequin or bust dressed in a cowl or headscarf. The background is plain, and the etching is signed "M. Gwennet" in the upper right corner. The edges of the image are surrounded by a border of blank yellowed paper.

artworks.title: Les cygnes
artworks.medium: carton gravé in light green on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows three swans swimming on a body of water. The swans are drawn with soft lines, floating on the water's surface. The drawing depicts gentle ripples and reflections in the water around the swans. The color palette is muted and light, creating a serene atmosphere. The scene is balanced and harmonious, evoking a sense of calm and peace.

artworks.title: L'orage
artworks.medium: woodcut in gray-green on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a shepherd leaning against a tree, surrounded by a flock of sheep. The background shows the horizon meeting distant foliage. The artwork is a woodcut print with black lines on beige paper, creating a stark contrast. The lines and shapes are bold and stylized, detailing the texture of the tree bark and sheep's wool. The color palette is monochrome, utilizing dark ink and light paper to establish depth and form.
